hypothesis: Fireplay v0.1.98 的 R2 外链卡不能等同于已丢失的本地视频草稿；原生视频卡的手动账号选择可保持自动上传请求。首次 Worker 分配前后的组显示也不能与上传人组混为一谈。

observations.trigger: A native-file upload draft is lost after a verified raw R2 stage
observations.observed: Restoring its public R2 URL through the batch-link textbox produced an external-link card without the native-file YouTube account selector and ready cover. A new native-file selection produced a local-video card with those controls.
observations.effective_action: Retain the prior stage receipt. In this incident a human explicitly authorized exactly one new raw stage for Japanese; the resulting material was imported once.
observations.failure_signature: An existing public video URL is playable but the link card has no per-video YouTube upload configuration.
observations.limit: Do not infer that a public URL can restore the native-file draft, and do not infer authorization to reupload unknown or already-uploaded items.

observations.trigger: Need an explicit requirement-group YouTube account on a native-video card
observations.observed: Leaving the ordinary/no-YouTube checkbox unchecked retained YouTube task creation. Switching the per-card account mode from automatic to manual exposed account selection. Choosing an account whose actual account-detail group was APC yielded a task specifying that account.
observations.effective_action: Record real account-detail group, per-video selection screenshot, final file hash, exact imported material ID and initial task/account mapping. The account global mode was not changed.
observations.limit: The manual selector label describes selection, not cancellation of automatic YouTube submission. This is an observed UI behavior, not a default-account guarantee.

observations.trigger: Task detail viewed before its first Worker claim
observations.observed: The task displayed the specified APC account email, but execution account was blank and the group showed the uploader group. After first claim the actual execution-account UUID and displayed group were APC. The extension metadata still carried the uploader group name.
observations.effective_action: Keep selected account ownership and uploader-group metadata distinct. Preserve the initial unassigned observation without fabricating execution-account or task-group verification.
observations.limit: This candidate does not authorize waiting for downstream completion. Current user instruction delegates upload progress to Fireplay after initial acceptance and binding.

limitations: One observed UI version and one requirement; no broader platform compatibility claim.
User exception applied to exactly one raw stage and is not a reusable authorization.
Self-review of initial account routing and Fireplay acceptance; no claim of downstream YouTube completion.
origin: Actual APC-20261027-020 return UI and explicit one-stage recovery authorization, 2026-10-27
next_action: Consult the concrete failure signature only when the same native-file draft recovery or account selector issue recurs; verify current UI before acting. No new paid experiment or new generic rule is requested.
